summary.en-US: The forecast test and the selection test have different outcomes and should be read separately.
summary.zh-CN: 预测检验与选股检验的结果不同，需要分开阅读。

title.en-US: Freeze target semantics and common rows
title.zh-CN: 固定目标语义与共同样本

question.en-US: Are revenue and net income evaluated on the same folds?
question.zh-CN: 营收与净利润是否使用共同折评估？

finding.en-US: The retrospective pilot uses 32,339 common rows and three annual test windows; net income is consolidated, not parent-attributable.
finding.zh-CN: 回溯试验使用 32,339 个共同样本、三个年度测试窗口；净利润为合并口径，不是归母口径。

decision.en-US: Interpret transformed errors within each target, not as currency-denominated MAE.
decision.zh-CN: 各目标内解读变换误差，不把它当作货币单位 MAE。

question.en-US: Do learned models improve absolute forecasts?
question.zh-CN: 学习模型是否改善绝对值预测？

finding.en-US: Persistence wins transformed MAE in all six target-year cells. XGBoost adds only a small net-income Rank IC increment.
finding.zh-CN: Persistence 在六个目标年单元的变换 MAE 全部胜出；XGBoost 净利润 Rank IC 增量很小。

decision.en-US: High revenue-level Rank IC can reflect firm scale; no model promotion follows.
decision.zh-CN: 营收水平 Rank IC 高可能反映公司规模，不据此提升模型资格。

question.en-US: Does better-looking forecast yield translate consistently?
question.zh-CN: 预测收益率指标的亮点是否一致兑现？

finding.en-US: Ridge forecast-yield excess is 16.4%, 41.8%, then -7.4%; annual selection outcomes disagree.
finding.zh-CN: Ridge 预测收益率组超额依次为 16.4%、41.8%、-7.4%，年度选股结论不一致。

decision.en-US: Keep the test retrospective; audit surviving-universe and later-revision biases separately.
decision.zh-CN: 保留回溯试验状态，单独审计幸存股票池与后来修订偏差。

context.en-US: Same common annual folds; target-specific transformed units, not currency units.
context.zh-CN: 同一年度共同折；目标特定的变换单位，不是货币单位。

interpretation.en-US: Persistence has the lowest error in each year.

context.en-US: Same annual folds; not directly comparable to revenue transformed MAE.
context.zh-CN: 同一年度折；不能与营收变换 MAE 直接比较。

interpretation.en-US: Small ranking gains do not compensate for worse absolute prediction error.
interpretation.zh-CN: 微小排序增量不能替代绝对预测误差改善。

title.zh-CN: 最高十分位年度超额诊断

metric.zh-CN: 最高十分位相对共同样本超额

context.en-US: Three annual price-label windows; no transaction costs, fillability or delisting-aware production proof.
context.zh-CN: 三个年度价格标签窗口；无交易成本、可成交性或退市感知生产证据。

interpretation.en-US: Forecast-yield rankings reverse; scale and valuation can dominate the bridge.
interpretation.zh-CN: 预测收益率排序会反转；规模与估值可能主导桥接。

next_question.en-US: Can a preregistered, observation-time cohort show a forecast increment and then costed selection value?
next_question.zh-CN: 预注册、受观察时间约束的样本能否先显示预测增量，再显示成本后选股价值？

before.en-US: Complex models might improve forecasts of financial levels.
before.zh-CN: 复杂模型可能改善财务水平预测。

trigger.en-US: Persistence wins all six transformed-MAE comparisons.
trigger.zh-CN: 持续性赢得全部六项变换 MAE 对照。

after.en-US: No learned-model promotion follows; test the selection bridge independently.
after.zh-CN: 不提升学习模型资格，独立检验选股桥接。
